defects.detail: 'Furor ex Erasmo, diuitis heri cuiusdam penu sentio' ("I steal from Erasmus" — I perceive it from a rich master's pantry) -> 'I feel that a frenzy is being stolen from the pantry of a certain rich master, Erasmus' (furor = I steal, read as 'frenzy')
final 'paulatim eijci' -> 'gradually' — 'eijci' (be ejected) dropped though it is on this page
'uirum mei nominis importunitate lacerari' (the man torn because of the nuisance of my name) -> 'a man of my name must be lacerated by importunity'
'gibbum Platonis et Aristotelis balbutiem ... exprimunt' (imitate Plato's hump and Aristotle's stammer) -> 'stammer with the hump of Plato and the stutter of Aristotle'

reason: Mostly faithful polemic, but misreads 'Furor ex Erasmo' (I steal) as 'frenzy', drops the closing 'eijci', and misparses 'mei nominis importunitate'
Allegations, theses 26–28 and footnotes a–e rendered fully and correctly (cessio actionum, viriles, privilegium fori); stops at 'nisi al-' as source does
Gendrian quatrain, subscription, dedication to Caspar and Andreas Bayer and the consolatory poem all rendered faithfully; nothing wrong found

reason: English commentary kept, Greek lease lines 1–15 and the back translated correctly; the line-note apparatus is partly flattened and line 16 is dropped

defects.detail: 'Dissentit hic Bodinus sine Bono, prout Jacobus Cuiacius Bodinum ... per anagrammatismum ... nominat' -> 'Bodin disagrees here without good reason, just as Cujas calls Bodin ... by anagram' — the anagram name 'sine Bono' is lost, so what Cujas calls him is gone
'præscriptis regalibus, jura superioritatis ... præscripta non esse' (when regalia are acquired by prescription, superiority is not) -> 'are not prescribed by the aforementioned royal rights'
'Imperatorem sibi in Imperio collegas et subditos pares effecisse' -> 'made his colleagues and peers of his subjects'; 'vasallum ... collegam vel subditum parem' -> 'a peer of the subject'

reason: Argument on superiority and regalia faithfully carried; several minor misparses (sine Bono pun, praescriptis regalibus, subditos pares)
